blocos.texto: The Shadow World is not another planet. It is **our world**, pressed against the real one, separated by a thin film — almost invisible, almost impassable. On one side are the *impure*: ordinary people, who see nothing. On the other, the Shadows and the Illuminated.

Caught in between are the few **Marked** children — touched as infants by a nameless force that leaves a spiral scar on the body. The mark draws everything in: the Shadows that feed on pain, and the gold-lit Illuminated who have hated them since the cradle.

corpo.texto: Every Marked child is born inside an invisible film that blocks the Shadows' direct touch. It shouldn't exist — it is an error, something *broken*.
The Shield cracks a little with every **Special Night** and every death tied to the Marked one. What happens when it breaks completely has not yet been documented.
Rare events where Shadows and Illuminated manifest at once. They always come with mass deaths and local collapses of reality.
The Marked draw these nights — and the gaps between them shorten before great tragedies. Minus has survived three.
The *Shadow World* is a distorted reflection of the real one, where the Shadows exist in solid form. Every city has its own version, each with a different level of corruption.
Entering that plane drains a human's body and mind within minutes. Minus crosses anyway — time runs differently there, and it lets him cover impossible distances in seconds.
